jobs.title: Project Assistant
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Project Assistant is responsible for planning, directing, and coordinating activities related to Aero. Responsibilities

• Working with operations and sales teams to coordinate field service aero-derivative gas turbine repair and/or overhaul projects from inception to completion.

• Ensuring that all jobs meet planned delivery dates and customer expectations.

• Communicating regularly and promptly with clients and internal stakeholders regarding ongoing work.

• Maintaining project budgets, Inspection Test Plans, and schedules.

• Coordinating with 3rd party vendors and internal Sulzer teams.

• Continually improve on processes & procedures to support quality and safety growth.
Qualifications:
The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :

• 5+ years of applicable project coordination, engineering, or operations experience

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Highly effective time management and organizational skills with the ability to coordinate multiple projects

• Strong MS Office skills (Excel, MS Project, etc.)

• Strong customer service skills and high motivation

• General knowledge of aero-derivative gas turbines and/or rotating equipment preferred, but not required

• PMP certification preferred, but not required

What we offer you

• 12 Paid Holidays

• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days

• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability

• 401K with 6% company match

• Employee Assistance Program

• Employee Wellness Program

• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center)

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

Job Summary
The HR & Payroll Sr. Admin Specialist is responsible for performing routine payroll and HR administrative tasks. This role ensures accurate data entry, maintains records, and supports compliance with established procedures.
This job profile is intended for experienced professional-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Key

jobs.title: CSS Sales/Service Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineer is responsible for supporting the sales process by providing technical expertise, assisting with product demonstrations, and preparing proposals. This role works closely with senior engineers and sales teams to ensure customer requirements are met.
This job profile is intended for early-career professionals who apply broad theoretical knowledge and require the ability to investigate and analyse problems. Solutions are typically discussed/verified with a more senior member. To visit customers and promote Sulzer spare parts sales
To coordinate with Sulzer CSS Industry Sales team and customers and assist to resolve the technical issues and win more parts/product sales.
To analyze the installed base volume and find potential companies to appoint as CSS channel partners at those appropriate regions.
To monitor, manage and support channel partners to enhance the Sulzer parts sales.
To visit customer plants and submit technical and commercial proposals to replace inefficient older pumps for both Sulzer/competitor pumps to maintain sustainable installed base volume.
To approach proactively with customers and submit quotes and technical proposals for parts sales and customer system upgrading using Sulzer Sense system.
To visit customers and promote Sulzer TB seal sales and win orders.
To attend customer complaints at site and resolve the customer complaints
To troubleshoot and resolve the technical issues at the customer site
To carry out installation supervisions and inspections at customer site and give feedback to the customer about possible
To carry out testing and commissioning of the equipment at the customer site
To conduct the customer trainings for installation, testing, commissioning, operation and maintenance of the equipment
To report to CSS Manager on daily activities and weekly work schedules.

Requirements

• Degree or Diploma In Electrical or Mechatronics or Mechanical Engineering

• Minimum 3 years working experience in Industry Pumps and various industry process systems would be preferable

• Market/product knowledge in various Industry products application and process would be preferable sales experience would be added an advantage.

• Willing to travel extensively within the country of appointment and other countries as and when required Valid Driving license

What we offer you

Career Opportunities
Medical Benefit
Saving Plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Als Teil der Business Unit Water & Industrial der Sulzer AG vertreibt die Sulzer Flow Germany GmbH Produkte und Lösungen zur mechanischen und biologischen Reinigung von kommunalem und industriellen Abwasser.

Als Service-Techniker sind Sie unser Gesicht zum Kunden. Auf Tages-Montagen untersuchen und lösen Sie auftretende Probleme in Kundenanlagen. Sie werden eingesetzt im Rahmen von Neumontagen, Inbetriebnahmen, Umbaumaßnahmen, Revisionen, Wartungen, Befundungen und Reparaturen von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen.
In dieser Stelle sind Sie verantwortlich für:

• Prüfung, Wartung & Reparatur von Pumpen, Hebeanlagen und Steuerungen am Einbauort

• Neuinstallation von Pumpstationen, Hebeanlagen und Schaltanlagen am Einbauort

• Störungsanalysen

• Beratung unserer Kunden bei technischen Fragestellungen

Um in dieser Stelle erfolgreich zu sein, sollten Sie Folgendes mitbringen:

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung als Mechatroniker/in (oder Elektroniker/in / Industriemechaniker/in oder vergleichbar)

• Idealerweise Elektrofachkraft für festgelegte Tätigkeiten (wird sonst als Weiterbildung durch uns durchgeführt)

• Erste Berufserfahrung als Servicetechniker/in von Vorteil

• Grundkenntnisse in Word und Excel

• Führerschein Klasse B

• Reisebereitschaft (ca. 80% Tagesreisen)

What we offer you

Bei Sulzer werden Sie Teil eines renommierten Teams. Wir bieten Ihnen ein hohes Maß an Eigenverantwortung, sowie ausgezeichnete Zukunftsperspektiven.

• Zukunftssichere Position in einem modernen und wachsenden Unternehmen

• Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

• Leistungsgerechte Vergütung, inkl. Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld

• 30 Tage Urlaub

• Intensive Einarbeitung und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

• Einsatzmöglichkeit vom Wohnort

• Top ausgestattete Service-Vans mit modernem Werkzeug

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Mechanical Engineer is responsible for designing and developing mechanical systems and components. This role applies engineering knowledge to support the planning, testing, and implementation of mechanical and electromechanical systems, including perform Finite Element Analysis (FEA) to analyze the structural integrity of the designed components.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision Purpose of the job

Execute engineering Task and act as Subject Expert Matter on mechanical engineering analysis and stress analysis with FEA software.

Main tasks and responsibilities

Analyze and calculate mechanical task issues such as stress analysis, etc.
Understand all advance mechanical engineering structural analysis, including stress concentration factors, ratio of stress to yield, etc.
Conduct advance analysis using Finite element Software, mainly with ANSYS Mechanical and its derivatives
Understand fundamental geometry modification
Understand advance meshing
Have full understanding of bounndary condition (constraints and force) application
Have understanding about fluid dynamic and CFD
Lead and conduct as required meetings with shop personnel, customers and others.
Perform communication / contact with customers on the technical issues or work progress.
Able to explain highly complex structural analysis in easily understandable terms

• Provide solutions for problems while performing the project with regards to quality, time, and cost.

• Prepare engineering report, including progress report.

Field Assignment

Lead engineer if needed for field service activity
Communicate with third party and / or with customer for technical assistance required.
Make and issue progress reports.

Vendor Qualification & Monitoring

Perform monitoring of vendors.
Communicate with vendors for feedback.

Quality Issues

Identify and develop new procedures as required
Support ISO Coordinator to monitor implementation of existing procedures in shop and conduct required training for co-workers.
Monitor and issue engineering quality objective report.

Skills & Qualifications

Mandatory :
Preferable Master degree in Mechanical/Aerospace/lightweigt structure Engineering, Bachelor with relevant experience will be strongly considered.
Having minimum 3 year experience in handling stress analysis and FE analysis, preferably within ANSYS Workbench framework
Experience in CAD Software, preferably Inventor or ANSYS Workbench derivatives
Experience in MS Windows environments, especially for presenting and reporting activities.
Have passion to get deep in FEA knowledge

Value-add :
Having minimum 3 year experiences in turbo-machinery or rotating equipment repair
Having minimum 3 year in API 687 exposure
Having experience/exposure in Fluid Dynamic Analysis, preferably within ANSYS Fluent/CFX framework
Having exposure to project-based workflow, project planning (such as with MS Project), timeline management, etc.

What we offer you

• Career Opportunities

• Medical Insurance

• Saving Plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Location: Pasadena, TX (1910 Jasmine Drive)
On‑site role with up to 40% field service

Job Summary
The Mechanical Engineer supports the inspection, repair, and documentation of rotating equipment by combining hands‑on shop and field work with engineering documentation and customer communication. This role works closely with the machine shop, quotation team, and customers to help define accurate repair scopes and ensure quality execution.

This position is intended for engineers with practical mechanical experience who can work independently with general guidance. Training will be provided as part of onboarding. This role is primarily based on‑site in Pasadena, TX, with occasional field service assignments (up to 40%). The engineer will split time between hands‑on mechanical work, inspections, measurements, and engineering documentation. The role requires close coordination with the repair shop, internal teams, and customers.

Key Responsibilities

• Support rotating equipment inspections and repair evaluations to help define accurate work scopes

• Act as a mechanical point of contact for customers during inspections and repairs

• Coordinate with the machine shop and quotation team on mechanical findings and requirements

• Create and update CAD drawings to document design or repair changes for customer review

• Perform or verify precision measurements using micrometers and calipers

• Participate in day‑to‑day shop and field operations, including repair support

• Assist with field service overhauls as required

• Document findings clearly and complete assigned tasks on schedule

Preferred (3+ years total across one or more of the following):

• Rotating equipment repair or overhaul

• Rotating equipment manufacturing

• Rotating equipment package design and assembly

• Field service for mechanical equipment

• Vibration analysis or diagnostics

Technical Skills & Knowledge

• Proficient with CAD software (SolidWorks or AutoDesk)

• Working knowledge of:

• Rolling element bearings

• Sleeve/babbitt bearings

• Mechanical seals and oil seals

• Shaft alignment

• Vibration spectrums and interpretation

• Comfortable using micrometers and calipers

• Familiarity with seal and bearing clearances to shafts is preferred

• If not already experienced, this skill will be taught on the job

Required Attributes

• Self‑motivated and willing to learn through on‑the‑job training

• Comfortable working in a hands‑on, industrial environment

• Able to take ownership of assigned work and complete tasks in a timely manner

• Strong attention to detail and communication skills

What we offer you

• Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• 401(k) with 6% company match

• Paid time off and paid holidays

• Paid parental leave

• Gym membership and wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Short- and long-term disability insurance

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician-HST
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Service Center Manager is responsible for supervising a team of technical professionals in delivering field service engineering support to customers. This role ensures the effective execution of service operations, resolves complex technical issues, and maintains high levels of customer satisfaction. The manager plays a key role in setting team goals, managing performance, and ensuring compliance with service standards.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ junior to experienced expert-level roles.
Summary : Responsible for conducting activities in our service warranty & spares department.

Essential Functions:

• Assist our customer base including our reps, distributors and authorized service centers with their service and technical needs

• Leads initial field trouble shooting and expedites technical and engineering support as needed

• Ensure customer satisfaction and loyalty by consulting with, assisting and resolving requests, inquiries and complaints, both verbally and in writing

• Handles inbound calls effectively and efficiently through the use of proactive customer service and have the knowledge and ability to handle general inquiry calls, as well as technical calls

• Exhibits strong interpersonal skills, is positive, pleasant, respectful and customer focused

• Creates a satisfying experience for the customer by using professional customer service techniques, personalizing and focusing on adding value

• Resolve questions / concerns efficiently and effectively

• Initiates return authorizations and creates customer file

• Makes warranty determinations based on evaluations performed by in-house and outsourced authorized service center evaluation reports

• Logs reports back to manufacturing units for back charging warranty claims

• Expedite service and warranty orders through the system until completion

• Follows quality procedures according to ISO 9001.

• Safety obligations:

• All employees understand and are able to explain the structure and objectives of the SBP.

• All employees follow the safety rules.

• All employees have "the right and duty to intervene" in the event a safety concern becomes evident. In addition, acceptance of an intervention should be accepted in a positive manner as it could have prevented an accident.

• All employees are required to comply with all work instructions, policies, and posted signs or instructions regarding safety, including but not limited to proper use of required PPE at all times.

Secondary Responsibilities:
· Resolves customer complaints
· Performs other duties as assigned

Supervisory Responsibilities:
· None

Qualifications:
· College degree preferred or equal job experience
· 5 years customer service experience
· Strong computer skills including but not limited to Windows XP / Microsoft Office / Use of Web
· Superior organizational skills
· Able to multi-task, keep to schedules and deadlines
· Ability to work independently and be team focused
· Mechanical background in rotating equipment a plus

Physical Requirements:
· Lifting up to 25 pounds
· Typing

What we offer you

• Competitive Paid Time Off

• 12 Company Paid Holidays per year

• Annual Bonus Program

• Full Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• Company Paid Short Term and Long Term Disability, Company Paid Life Insurance

• 6% 401K or Roth Company Match with Immediate Vesting

• Company Paid Retirement Security Contributions following 1 year of employment

• Tuition Reimbursement/Educational Assistance

• Quarterly Gym Reimbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in

jobs.title: Indirect Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Procurement Specialist is responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and procuring goods and services required by the organization, including both direct and indirect materials. This role ensures cost-effective purchasing strategies, supplier performance management, and contract administration to support operational efficiency. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. El Especialista en Compras Indirectas será responsable de gestionar el proceso de adquisición de bienes y servicios indirectos, optimizando costos y asegurando el cumplimiento de las políticas de la empresa.

Responsabilidades del Puesto

* Identificar, evaluar y seleccionar proveedores para bienes y servicios indirectos (ej. MRO, TI, servicios profesionales, viajes, etc.).
* Negociar contratos y acuerdos comerciales con proveedores para obtener las mejores condiciones de precio, calidad y servicio.
* Desarrollar y mantener relaciones sólidas con proveedores clave.
* Gestionar el ciclo de vida de los contratos, incluyendo revisiones, renovaciones y terminaciones.
* Colaborar con los departamentos internos para comprender sus necesidades de adquisición y asegurar la disponibilidad oportuna de los bienes y servicios.
* Analizar el gasto en compras indirectas e identificar oportunidades de ahorro y eficiencia.
* Garantizar el cumplimiento de las políticas y procedimientos internos de compras, así como las regulaciones externas aplicables.
* Mantener actualizados los sistemas de información de compras y la base de datos de proveedores.
* Elaborar reportes de desempeño de proveedores y gasto para la toma de decisiones.

Cualificaciones del Puesto

* Licenciatura en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Comercio Internacional o campo relacionado.
* Mínimo de 3 años de experiencia en compras indirectas, preferiblemente en un entorno industrial o manufacturero.

jobs.title: Senior ICT Supporter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

• Provide 2nd‑level IT support, both on‑site and remotely, for all users of Sulzer Ltd, primarily within the assigned region and, if required, across other regions

• Monitor and maintain the entire local IT infrastructure, including desktop and mobile Windows devices, MFPs, company‑specific hardware and software, user and access management, servers, network components, etc.

• Install and configure end‑user devices, including mobile phones

• Handle hardware procurement and inventory management

• Receive, analyze, and resolve incidents and service requests within 2nd‑level support using standard IT tools

• Escalate incidents and service requests to 3rd‑level support, external local service providers, or management when required

• Perform tasks in accordance with ITIL standards, primarily using the company’s internal ticketing system ServiceNow (SNOW), while adhering to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Technically coordinate and set up video conferences (Microsoft Teams / Yealink)

• Manage and maintain internal meeting room infrastructure

• Collaborate on and support local and global IT projects

• Train and coach new employees and trainees

Special Key Responsibilities

• Provide specialized IT support and daily assistance to VIP users, including support during external executive meetings and town halls

• Member of a cross‑functional team (DevOps: Local IT – Datacenter)

To succeed in this role, you will need:

• Successfully completed IT education or training

• Several years of professional experience in 2nd‑ and/or 3rd‑level IT support

• Experience in VIP support is an advantage (preferably in a comparable corporate environment)

• Broad knowledge in network (Cisco), DDC (Hyper-V), AD, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Azure, Intune etc.

• ITIL and/or Microsoft certifications (Server / Client / Network) are an advantage

• Very good English skills and good German skills would be a strong advantage.

• Strong customer‑ and service‑oriented mindset

• Analytical, structured, and solution‑oriented approach

• Ability to work independently as well as in a team‑oriented environment

• Flexibility regarding tasks and working hours, and willingness to undertake occasional business travel

• Availability to work in shift hours (7am - 4pm / 9am - 6pm)

What we offer you

• 25 days holidays (exclusive of bank holidays) + service days

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program/health care

• On-site car parking/public transport allowance

• Access to a wide range of discounts

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Alexi Donadoni at alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Winder Fitter
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Sulzer has a proud heritage of over 180 years in engineering excellence, specialising in pumps, agitators, compressors, and critical rotating equipment across industries. At our Sutton-in-Ashfield Service Centre, we lead the way in delivering world-class electro-mechanical repairs and overhauls for the UK Rail Sector – ensuring the reliability and safety of the trains that keep our country moving.

A key part of this is precision winding. From traction motors to auxiliary systems, expertly rewound motors are essential for keeping fleets operational, efficient, and on schedule. Every coil, every turn matters and that’s where our skilled team makes the difference.

We are looking for an experienced Mechnaical Fitter to join us, helping maintain the highest standards in motor rewinds and repairs for our rail customers. Job Responsibilities

• Dismantle, rewind, reassemble, and test single-phase and three-phase AC motors, small DC motors, and associated equipment including pumps and gearboxes

• Carry out incoming inspections for damage and evidence of electrical malfunctions to set procedures

• Prepare and inspect all reusable parts for rewinding

• Operate specialised winding and testing equipment such as winding machines, surge testers, and core-loss testers

• Complete all job documentation, including photographs, accurately and on time

Job Qualifications

• Recognised electrical engineering or electrical machine repair & rewinds apprenticeship (or equivalent)

• Proven experience dismantling, rewinding, assembling, and testing AC/DC motors

• Experience with a wide range of mechanical and electrical rotating equipment

• Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings

• Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and commitment to quality

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• Paid overtime opportunities

• Annual companywide bonus

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash, helping you cover everyday health costs like dental, optical, and physiotherapy, plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you, your family, and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• We’re proud to support those who’ve served. Sulzer is a Bronze Award holder under the MoD’s Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, meaning we actively welcome and support ex-military personnel and reservists in building successful careers with us.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Ingénieur QESH
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Quality Engineer is responsible for managing quality engineering processes and supporting manufacturing operations to ensure product compliance. This includes defining quality standards, auditing outputs, and resolving defects.
This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Résumé du poste

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur QESH (Qualité, Environnement, Santé, Sécurité) pour rejoindre notre équipe chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU. Le titulaire du poste sera responsable de l'élaboration, de la mise en œuvre et du maintien des systèmes de gestion intégrés QESH afin de garantir la conformité réglementaire et l'amélioration continue des performances.

Responsabilités du poste

* Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique et les objectifs QESH en accord avec la stratégie du groupe.
* Assurer la conformité avec les réglementations nationales et internationales en matière de qualité, d'environnement, de santé et de sécurité.
* Développer, maintenir et améliorer le système de management intégré QESH (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001).
* Réaliser des audits internes et externes QESH et suivre les plans d'actions correctives et préventives.
* Analyser les incidents, accidents et non-conformités, et proposer des solutions pour éviter leur récurrence.
* Mettre en place et suivre les indicateurs de performance QESH.
* Animer et sensibiliser le personnel aux bonnes pratiques QESH par des formations et des communications régulières.
* Gérer la documentation QESH (procédures, instructions, enregistrements).
* Assurer la veille réglementaire QESH et anticiper les évolutions.
* Participer à l'analyse des risques professionnels et environnementaux.

Qualifications du poste

* Diplôme d'ingénieur ou Master spécialisé en QESH, QHSE, ou domaine équivalent.
* Minimum 3 à 5 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, idéalement dans un environnement industriel.
* Solide connaissance des normes ISO 9001, ISO 14001 et ISO 45001.
* Maîtrise de la réglementation française en matière de QESH.
* Capacité à analyser, synthétiser et résoudre des problèmes complexes.
* Excellentes compétences en communication, pédagogie et leadership.
* Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l'organisation.
* Maîtrise du Pack Office.
* Anglais courant (écrit et oral) indispensable.

What we offer you

X

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: ESH Specialist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

At Sulzer, safety isn’t a policy — it’s a mindset. We’re now looking for an experienced ESH Specialist to take ownership of Environment, Safety and Health across our Southern UK Service Centres, supporting the teams that keep some of the world’s most critical rotating equipment running.

While this role is home‑based, it involves regular travel to our service centres and a strong on‑site presence to ensure effective engagement, impact and support across the business. What do our Service Centres do?
Sulzer Service Centres are the operational heart of our Services business. They provide repair, overhaul, maintenance and upgrade solutions for rotating equipment including pumps, motors and turbomachinery used across energy, water, chemicals, industrial and infrastructure sectors.

The role
As ESH Specialist, you’ll be the subject‑matter expert and trusted partner to our site leaders across the Southern Service Centres. You’ll lead, coach and challenge the business to continually raise ESH standards while ensuring compliance with legal, corporate and customer requirements.

Key responsibilities include:

• Owning and driving the ESH agenda across Southern Service Centres

• Ensuring compliance with UK ESH legislation, Sulzer standards and customer requirements

• Conducting site audits, inspections and risk assessments

• Supporting incident investigations, corrective actions and continuous improvement

• Coaching managers and operational teams to embed a strong safety culture

• Supporting environmental initiatives and sustainability objectives

• Acting as the key ESH interface between sites, regional leadership and the wider Group EHS function

What we’re looking for:

• Proven experience in an ESH / HSE / SHE role within engineering, manufacturing or service environments is preferred; however, we’re most interested in the right person with the right mindset and approach.

• NEBOSH or equivalent qualification

• Strong working knowledge of UK ESH legislation and best practice

• Confident communicator able to influence at all levels, from shop floor to senior leadership

• Comfortable working independently across multiple sites

• Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel regularly

What we offer you

• A competitive basic salary

• A company-wide bonus scheme based on company performance

• The option of a Car or Allowance - EV options are available.

• 33 days annual leave.

• Defined pension contributions.

• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

• Confidential support via Employee Assistance Programmes.

• Access to discounts on shopping entertainment lifestyle plus opportunity to apply for Costco membership.

• Discounted personal car leasing for you your family and friends.

• Long Service Awards celebrating your commitment.

• Continuous learning opportunities through Sulzer Learning Pathways.

• As a Bronze Award holder of the MoD Defence Employer Recognition Scheme, we welcome and support veterans, reservists and Cadet Adult Volunteers with policies for training, camps and deployment, plus a growing internal military network.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

We’re now looking for an experienced ESH Specialist to take ownership of Environment, Safety and Health across our Southern UK Service Centres, supporting the teams that keep some of the world’s most critical rotating equipment running. While this role is home‑based, it involves regular travel to our service centres and a strong on‑site presence to ensure effective engagement, impact and support across the business. What do our Service Centres do? Sulzer Service Centres are the operational heart of our Services business. They provide repair, overhaul, maintenance and upgrade solutions for rotating equipment including pumps, motors and turbomachinery used across energy, water, chemicals, industrial and infrastructure sectors. The role As ESH Specialist, you’ll be the subject‑matter expert and trusted partner to our site leaders across the Southern Service Centres. You’ll lead, coach and challenge the business to continually raise ESH standards while ensuring compliance with legal, corporate and customer requirements. Key responsibilities include:
• Owning and driving the ESH agenda across Southern Service Centres
• Ensuring compliance with UK ESH legislation, Sulzer standards and customer requirements
• Conducting site audits, inspections and risk assessments
• Supporting incident investigations, corrective actions and continuous improvement
• Coaching managers and operational teams to embed a strong safety culture
• Supporting environmental initiatives and sustainability objectives
• Acting as the key ESH interface between sites, regional leadership and the wider Group EHS function What we’re looking for:
• Proven experience in an ESH / HSE / SHE role within engineering, manufacturing or service environments is preferred; however, we’re most interested in the right person with the right mindset and approach.
• NEBOSH or equivalent qualification
• Strong working knowledge of UK ESH legislation and best practice
• Confident communicator able to influence at all levels, from shop floor to senior leadership
• Comfortable working independently across multiple sites
• Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel regularly What we offer you
• A competitive basic salary
• A company-wide bonus scheme based on company performance
• The option of a Car or Allowance - EV options are available.
• 33 days annual leave.
• Defined pension contributions.
• Access to Medicash helping you cover everyday health costs like dental optical and physiotherapy plus a range of wellbeing perks.

jobs.title: MRP Controller and Planning Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Responsible for end‑to‑end production and material planning through effective MRP execution, inventory control, and cross‑functional coordination to ensure smooth order flow from planning to delivery.

Key Responsibilities

• Achieve ≥92% On‑Time Delivery and 100% Sales Order Compliance.

• Execute MRP planning, ensuring accurate and timely release of BOMs and requisitions.

• Plan, schedule, and close planned and production orders aligned with forecasts and customer dates.

• Manage routings and production order closures to meet operational targets.

• Monitor end‑to‑end order timelines (PR, PO, production, and delivery) and resolve delays.

• Coordinate with Purchasing, Manufacturing, Quality, Warehouse, and Logistics for seamless execution.

• Optimize inventory and material flow to support production, backlog clearance, and OTD performance.

• Drive digital planning improvements and COGS reduction initiatives through process optimization.

Qualifications / Requirements

• Bachelor Mechanical Engineering

• 5-8 Years of Experience in MRP and Planning (End to end execution)

• SAP PP and MM, MS Excel, RFC and compliance

• Production Planning & Control

• Inventory Management & Optimization

• Strong Communication Skills

• Attention to Detail

• Time & Priority Management

• Collaboration & Teamwork

What we offer you

• A great working environment.

• Excellent opportunities for development, along with a competitive salary and company bonus scheme.

• Work Location: Riyadh- Industrial Area 2

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: MRO Gas Turbine Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
Sulzer GT Aero is seeking an experienced MRO Gas Turbine Engineer to provide technical expertise and support for the maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) of gas turbine components and systems. This role is crucial in ensuring the reliable and efficient operation of critical equipment for our clients. Job Responsibilities

• Setting technical specifications for the overhaul, inspection, and repair of aero-derivative gas turbines

• Overseeing disassembly, inspection and reassembly activities, ensuring compliance with engineering drawings, tolerances and standards

• Leading troubleshooting and diagnostic investigations, identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions

• Driving continuous improvement initiatives, applying Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to enhance efficiency and reduce downtime

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams including design engineers, OEMs, supply chain, and operations to deliver seamless project execution

Job Qualifications

• Strong technical expertise in gas turbines and rotating equipment, with practical experience of MRO environments

• Proven track record in repair schemes, diagnostics, and troubleshooting

• Knowledge of RB211 and/or Avon products (desirable but not essential)

• Experience in root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions

• The ability to interpret data from sensors and diagnostic tools to identify and resolve faults

• A degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent experience (preferred)

• A collaborative mindset with excellent communication skills and attention to detail

What we offer you

• A competitive base salary

• Annual Bonus scheme based on personal and company performance

• 33 days’ annual leave

• Private Medical Insurance (Self)

• Access free on-site parking and employee discounts across shopping, lifestyle, and entertainment

• Use our Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support services and wellbeing resources

• Develop your skills through continuous learning and Sulzer Learning Pathways

• Be part of a supportive, innovative team with genuine opportunities for career progression

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Manual Machinist
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

As a Manual Machinist you will be responsible for setting up and operating machine tools, including HBM, VBM, lathes, milling machines, ID/OD grinders, planers, and bore parts to manufacture and recondition component parts to customer, OEM and industry standards. You will interpret mechanical drawings, blueprints, and sketches and perform precision metal cutting, grinding, shaping and fitting. You will measure components, parts, and raw materials with precision measuring instruments, gauges, and tools. Key Responsibilities

• Performing layouts, setting up and operating conventional machine tools as required

• Reading and interpreting all drawings, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing

• Designing setup methods where none exist

• Instructing other shop personnel on proper machining techniques

• Continually improving methods to deliver higher quality with improved costs

Qualifications / Requirements

• Completion of a machinist apprentice program or equivalent training

• Ability to hold close tolerances and conduct component inspections

• Ability to set up machine tools: ID / OD Grinders, Turret Lathe, Engine Lathe, Horizontal Boring Mill, Vertical Boring Mill, Radial Drill, Planer Mill

• Four years of experience in machine shop operations

• Willingness to work in a team environment

• Openness to working overtime as required

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Warranty Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

The Warranty Manager is responsible for the end‑to‑end management of complex warranty claims, acting as the primary interface between customers and internal stakeholders while applying advanced technical, commercial, and organizational expertise to ensure timely, compliant, and cost‑effective resolution, maintain customer satisfaction, prevent escalation, and protect the company’s commercial and reputational interests.

Key Responsibilities

Warranty Claims & Process Management

• Manage warranty claims as technical projects or standardized end-to-end processes from claim initiation through successful resolution and closure.

• Develop and maintain claim resolution plans, schedules, cost estimates, and closure criteria.

• Control and monitor claim progress against contractual obligations, internal policies, and agreed service levels (SLAs).

• Ensure full traceability, documentation integrity, and compliance throughout the warranty lifecycle.

Customer & Stakeholder Interface

• Act as the single point of contact between the customer and internal stakeholders for all warranty-related matters.

• Maintain close, structured, and transparent communication with customers to manage expectations and avoid escalation.

• Coordinate internally with Engineering, Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Service teams to enable timely and aligned resolutions.

• Facilitate technical and commercial discussions to achieve balanced, win–win outcomes within contractual and financial boundaries.

Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline

• Control and monitor warranty claim expenditures to ensure alignment with the approved and allocated budget.

• Track actual warranty costs versus provisions and budgets, identifying variances proactively.

• Implement cost containment and optimization measures without compromising resolution effectiveness or customer satisfaction.

• Coordinate with Finance and relevant stakeholders to ensure accurate cost allocation, forecasting, and reporting.

• Support recovery actions from suppliers, sub-vendors, or third parties, where applicable, to minimize net warranty exposure.

Technical Analysis & Problem Resolution

• Lead technical investigations and root cause analysis for complex or recurring warranty issues.

• Validate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to ensure sustainable resolution and risk reduction.

• Escalate critical technical, quality, or commercial risks with clear impact assessment and recommendations.

Customer Satisfaction & Feedback Management

• Ensure customer satisfaction throughout the warranty claim lifecycle by delivering timely, high-quality, and transparent claim resolution.

• Own customer feedback related to warranty claims, including collection, analysis, response, and closure.

• Address customer concerns proactively to prevent dissatisfaction and preserve long-term customer relationships.

• Translate customer feedback into improvement actions in coordination with Engineering, Quality, and Service teams.

Performance Management & Continuous Improvement

• Ensure warranty activities align with departmental KPIs, including Warranty Cost Control & Financial Discipline.

• Monitor performance indicators such as claim cycle time, escalation rate, customer satisfaction, and recurrence trends.

• Identify systemic issues and contribute to process, design, or quality improvements to reduce future warranty exposure.

• Capture and communicate lessons learned to relevant stakeholders and governance forums.

Leadership & Capability Development

• Provide technical and process guidance to junior professionals involved in warranty claim execution.

• Review work outputs for accuracy, quality, and compliance with standar

jobs.title: Repair Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

Acts as the liaison between the customer, sales, vendors, engineering, and production departments, determines and provides detailed cost summaries and quotations for repair jobs in the service center. Coordinates repair by providing Work Instructions that include all pertinent information needed to process the repair through the service center meeting ISO requirements. Key Responsibilities

• Reviews customer requirement for pump repair

• Analyzes inspection results, works with shop personnel and Area Superintendent to determine scope of work required for repairs

• Plans repairs (labor hours, purchase requirements, work instructions, and total cost)

• Generates repair quotes

• Completes disassembly, inspection, repair, and assembly work instruction packages, (work orders, prints, procedures, inspection forms).

• Make/ review sketches and drawings to ISO standard and in AutoCAD where required.

• Completes purchase requisitions. Consults with vendors to determine availability, quality, quantity, and best pricing of all materials relative to a given job.

• Evaluates supplier quotations and determines acceptable quality, quantity, and pricing requirements to meet commitments made to customers.

• When necessary, expedite parts and materials from suppliers to ensure delivery commitments are met.

• As applicable, prepare and facilitate all inbound/ outbound shipping related tasks required for the final transportation of repairs. This may include all shipping, import, and export documentation as required.

• Manage projects to meet tender and order cycle time objectives for the service center.

• To ensure compliance with customer commitments and overall master schedule communicates regularly with all departments to keep them abreast of coordination activities

• All work is performed by ISO and OSHAS requirements

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management system which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures. Support and cooperate in company-wide improvement initiatives.

• Perform root cause analysis on pump failures

• Perform basic material selections for repair projects

• Perform engineering calculations per industry and Sulzer standards

• Performs other duties as assigned

Qualifications / Requirements

• Strong organizational, interpersonal and analytical skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills; including diplomacy and negotiation skills

• Solid knowledge of all manufacturing and shop processes related to repair of pumps and manufacturing of pump parts and or closely related equipment required

• Strong PC skills, with proficiency in Microsoft software

• Working experience and knowledge of ERP systems required. Previous SAP experience strongly desired but not critical.

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering is preferred

• Experience in closely related roles is preferred.

• Technical knowledge of pump design and repair, and fit form and functions of components is preferred.

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym re-imbursement

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Pump Mechanic
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary

We are looking for someone who is team-oriented, committed to quality work and a quick learner. Some experience in the light and/or heavy duty equipment is a plus. Key Responsibilities

• Plan for and prepare product for transfer to and from customers.

• Receive goods into our facility.

• Provide tracking information and freight quotes upon request. Inventory and order packaging supplies when needed. Source and hire freight companies for local and long-distance deliveries.

• Learn to disassemble all types of pumping equipment.

• Removes, cleans and prepares all types of pumping equipment components for inspection.

• Learn to inspect and records measurements of component parts and prepare inspection documentation.

• Maintains tools and equipment as required to keep them in good operation condition

• Provides incoming goods receiving information to allow a smooth transition for other coworkers to follow through with in-process work during working hours.

• Assist’s other team members as directed, including training with and working directly under a more senior co-worker.

• Supports, cooperates with, and participates in company-wide LEAN and EHS Management System which includes following all safety, health and environmental policies and procedures

• Provides excellent customer service to all your customers both internal and externally.

• Learns to perform minor set up and basic machining of non-critical component parts under Journeymen’s watch.

• Open to and shows desire to learn to weld and be certified in multiple disciplines of welding.

• Drives Company owned vehicles less than 10000# GVW when required.

• Perform other duties and/or administrative duties as assigned.

Qualifications / Requirements

• High School diploma or equivalent.

• Good computer skills (Microsoft Office, UPS & Fed-Ex applications).

• Ability to detect and correct paperwork errors or discrepancies as necessary.

• Ability to carry out routine verbal and written instructions.

• Must be able to regularly lift 50lbs

What we offer you

• 15 days of paid time off and 12 company-paid holidays

• 401k plan with a 6% match

• Comprehensive health plan including medical, dental, vision, Life, short-term & long-term disability

• Health savings account matching

• Motivating wellness program

• Employee Assistance Program

• Paid paternal leave

• Gym reimbursement

jobs.title: Technical Sales Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Manager supports the sales process by providing technical expertise and helping customers understand how products meet their needs. This role bridges the gap between engineering and sales, ensuring technical accuracy and customer satisfaction.
This job profile is intended for professionals who apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals. Purpose of the job

The role is responsible for driving sustainable Order Intake growth for Sulzer Chemtech’s Mass Transfer Components (MTC) business through:

• Active hunting of brownfield revamp opportunities from existing operating assets

• Early involvement and development of greenfield / grassroot CAPEX projects, from feasibility to FID

• Providing front‑end technical sales leadership, translating customer process challenges into differentiated, value‑based MTC solutions

Main tasks and responsibilities
Revamp & Brownfield

• Proactively identify revamp, debottlenecking, capacity expansion, separation efficiency improvement, and reliability upgrade opportunities in existing operating plants

• Ability to conduct asset‑level analysis (age of internals, operating issues, performance gaps, fouling, corrosion, capacity creep, energy efficiency requirements)

• Drive revamp‑led sales strategies, including Tray replacement, Packing retrofits (random ↔ structured), Mist eliminator and separator upgrades, Hydraulic rating changes and column internals optimization

• Position Sulzer as a lifecycle partner, not just an equipment supplier

Greenfield/Grassroot Project Development

• Actvely pursue new CAPEX grassroot projects

• Engage customers, licensors, consultants & EPCs early (feasibility,pre-FEED,FEED)

• Coordinate with application & technology, global applications teams in accordance to Sulzer project governance to lock in Sulzer MTC solutions early.

Technical & Application Leadership

• Translate customer challenges into value-based technical proposals that differentiate MTC from competitors with Application & Technology team.

• Order Intake & Sales Achievement
Deliver annual Order Intake targets, ensuring both revenue and expected margin objectives are met.

• Strategic Planning & Execution
Implement long‑term and short‑term business strategies and ensure alignment with regional and global MTCS initiatives.

• Proposal Follow-up & CRM Management
Proactively follow up on outstanding proposals and maintain accurate, up-to-date information in the Sulzer Customer Relationship Management system.

• Cross-Functional Coordination
Collaborate closely with Head Office, Regional Offices, and local intermediaries to support project acquisition, proposal development, and market initiatives.

• Market Intelligence & Reporting
Provide regular updates on market trends, competitive landscape, project pipeline, and sales forecasts to support strategic decision-making.

• Lead country-level market mapping , demand analysis, competitive intelligence, and customer segmentation

• Compliance & Governance
Ensure all commercial activities comply with local legal requirements, industry regulations, and company policies and procedures.

• Other Duties
Perform any additional business related tasks assigned by the superior to support business objectives.

Educational background

• Degree in Chemical Engineering or closely related disciplines such as Process Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with proven process equipment and mass transfer experience.

Professional experience & knowledge

• Minimum 5 years process equipment selling in Upstream, Refinery, Chemical & Petrochemical industry

• Knowledge

jobs.title: Estagiário(a) de Engenharia
Sales Engineering Metals
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sales Engineering Expert is responsible for providing technical expertise during the sales process, supporting the development of tailored solutions for clients, and ensuring alignment between customer needs and product capabilities.
This job profile is intended for recognized subject matter experts in a job area. Required to manage large projects or processes with limited oversight from manager. Coaches, reviews and delegates work to lower level professionals. Role Overview
In this role, you will actively shape and develop the Metals market in Mexico by working closely with end customers, EPCs, and distributors to create tailored technical and commercial solutions. Leveraging our portfolio of pumps, mixers, and water treatment solutions, you will help customers improve process efficiency, reliability, and sustainability , in line with the strategic objectives of the Flow Division within the Water & Industry business unit.
Through regular customer engagement, strong technical understanding, and personal networking, you will build long‑term partnerships and position Sulzer as a trusted solution provider across the Mexican metals industry

Key Responsibilities
Market Development & Sales Strategy

• Implement and execute the sales strategy for the Metals segment in Mexico.

• Actively develop the market by identifying new opportunities, key accounts, and strategic projects.

• Build a sustainable pipeline that supports long‑term growth and profitability.

Customer, EPC & Distributor Engagement

• Establish and maintain strong, trust‑based relationships with customers, EPCs, and selected distributors.

• Ensure early involvement in project development phases to influence technical solutions and specifications.

• Act as the main technical and commercial interface between Sulzer and assigned customers.

Solution Development

• Analyze customer processes and operational challenges.

• Leverage deep knowledge of the Sulzer portfolio to develop customized, competitive, and value‑adding solutions.

• Demonstrate clear customer value through improved performance, reliability, lifecycle cost reduction, and sustainability.

Proposals & Contract Management

• Prepare and manage formal technical and commercial proposals, ensuring clarity in scope, pricing, delivery, and contractual terms.

• Coordinate internally with engineering, product management, service, and operations teams to deliver accurate and competitive offers.

• Support negotiations and order intake in line with margin and risk guidelines.

Market & Trend Monitoring

• Monitor market developments, customer investment plans, and competitor activity.

• Translate market intelligence into targeted sales and marketing actions.

• Contribute to segment strategy, forecasting, and opportunity planning.

Success in This Role Looks Like

• Strong presence and credibility in the Mexican metals industry

• Early positioning in EPC‑driven projects

• Consistent opportunity creation and conversion

• Long‑term customer partnerships and repeat business

• Profitable growth aligned with Flow Division strategy

What we offer you

NA

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: Téchnicien Service/Field Service Technician
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Lead (Field) Service Technician is responsible for installing, configuring, calibrating, and repairing technical products and systems at customer field locations. This role performs a variety of maintenance and technical support tasks and may provide onsite training to customer support personnel.
This job profile is intended for experienced support-level staff that generally works autonomously and only requires closer supervision in non-routine situations. Résumé du poste**

En tant que Technicien de Service (Field Service Technician) chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU, vous serez responsable de l'installation, de la maintenance préventive et corrective, ainsi que du dépannage de nos équipements sur les sites de nos clients. Vous assurerez un service de haute qualité, garantissant la satisfaction client et le bon fonctionnement de nos produits.

Responsabilités**

* Effectuer des interventions de maintenance préventive et corrective sur les pompes, agitateurs et autres équipements Sulzer Ensival Moret.
* Diagnostiquer les pannes et dysfonctionnements, proposer des solutions techniques et les mettre en œuvre.
* Réaliser des installations et mises en service d'équipements neufs.
* Former les clients à l'utilisation et à la maintenance de premier niveau des produits.
* Rédiger des rapports d'intervention détaillés et précis (rapports techniques, feuilles de temps, etc.).
* Gérer son stock de pièces détachées et outils de manière autonome.
* Assurer un reporting régulier à son responsable et aux équipes internes (ventes, support technique).
* Respecter scrupuleusement les règles de sécurité, les procédures internes et les normes en vigueur.
* Participer à la veille technologique et à l'amélioration continue des processus.

Qualifications**

* Diplôme de niveau Bac+2/3 en maintenance industrielle, mécanique, électromécanique, ou équivalent.
* Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en maintenance d'équipements industriels, idéalement dans le domaine des pompes ou des machines tournantes.
* Solides connaissances en mécanique, hydraulique, électricité et automatisme industriel.
* Capacité à lire et interpréter des schémas techniques (mécaniques, électriques, hydrauliques).
* Maîtrise des outils de diagnostic et de mesure.
* Autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'organisation et esprit d'équipe.
* Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et au service client.
* Permis de conduire B valide (déplacements fréquents sur le territoire national).
* Maîtrise du français (écrit et oral) indispensable.
* Des connaissances en anglais technique seraient un plus.

What we offer you

.

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.title: HR Administration & Payroll Manager
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

The HR Administration & Payroll Manager is responsible for leading and overseeing all HR administrative processes and end-to-end payroll operations for Switzerland. This role ensures full compliance with Swiss labor law, social security regulations, tax obligations, and internal policies. The position acts as the primary point of contact for HR operations, employee lifecycle administration, payroll accuracy, and HR system integrity. The role needs hands-on execution, ensuring efficient HR processes and high-quality service delivery to employees and managers.
Your main tasks and responsibilities

Payroll Management (Swiss Payroll)

• Oversee and execute monthly payroll for all Swiss employees, including variable pay, allowances, deductions, and absences.

• Manage payroll controls, reconciliations, audits, and reporting activities.

• Ensure correct calculation of taxes, social security contributions, pension fund deductions, and insurance premiums.

• Act as key contact for employees on payroll, benefits, and time management topics.

• Collaborate with Finance on payroll accounting, salary provision, and audit requirements.

• Manage year‑end activities (salary certificates, Withholding Tax year closing, social security reporting)

HR Administration & Employee Lifecycle Management

• Act as a trusted HR advisor to managers and senior leaders based in Switzerland

• Manage and oversee all administrative HR processes for the entire employee lifecycle (hire to retire).

• Prepare employment contracts, amendments, reference letters, and other legal documents in accordance with Swiss law.

• Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records and digital personnel files.

• Manage onboarding and offboarding processes, including work permits (L, B, C) and liaison with authorities.

• Ensure timely registration and reporting to social security institutions (AHV/ALV/IV/EO), pension funds (BVG/LPP), accident insurance (UVG), KTG and family allowance offices.

• Support annual performance and compensation cycles from an administrative standpoint.

• Ensure compliance with internal policies, GDPR, and Swiss data protection regulations.

HR Systems & Process Optimization

• Maintain and optimize HRIS and time‑tracking systems (e.g., SAP, Workday, Abacus, or similar).

• Ensure data accuracy and reliability for reporting and analytics.

• Drive process improvements and standardization across HR administration and payroll.

• Support implementation of new tools and digital HR solutions.

• Compliance, Policies & Governance.

• Ensure full compliance with Swiss labour law, collective labour agreements (if applicable), and company policies.

• Maintain HR governance frameworks and support HR audits.

• Keep up to date with regulatory changes and translate them into operational processes.

To succeed in this role, you will need

• Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Several years of experience in HR administration and Swiss payroll (mandatory).

• Strong understanding of Swiss labour law, social security system, taxes, and employment compliance.

• Experience in multinational environments is an asset.

• Strong MS Office and HRIS proficiency; payroll system expertise required.

• Fluent in German and English.

• Working time: 80 - 100 %.

No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role.

Do you have a question about the role?

Reach out to Alexi Donadoni at alexi.donadoni@sulzer.com.

What we offer you

• 25 days holidays (exclusive of bank holidays) + service days

• Defined contribution pension scheme

• Employee Assistance Program/health care

• On-site car parking/public transport allowance

• Access to a wide range of discounts

Sulzer is an equal opportunity em

jobs.title: Teamleiter Field Service Operations (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The (Field) Service Team Lead is responsible for supervising professional-level employees in the field service team. This role sets day-to-day operational objectives, ensures adherence to procedures, and supports the delivery of high-quality technical services to customers.
This job profile is intended for People Managers of 4+ professional-level roles. Ihre Aufgaben

• Fachliche Führung und Koordination der Servicetechniker sowie Begleitung der lokalen Servicekoordinatoren bei regionalen Themen

• Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen operativen Servicebetriebs in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Einsatzplanung

• Eskalationsinstanz bei komplexen oder kritischen Serviceeinsätzen

• Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung der Servicequalität sowie Einhaltung von Sicherheits‑ und Qualitätsstandards (u. a. DGUV, ATEX)

• Durchführung und Begleitung von Safety Walks, Schulungen und technischen Unterweisungen

• Monitoring zentraler Service‑KPIs wie Auslastung, Reaktionszeiten und Qualitätskennzahlen

• Unterstützung bei technischen Fragestellungen, Fehleranalysen und Kundeneskalationen

• Enge Abstimmung mit dem Head of Service in allen personal‑ und organisationsrelevanten Themen

• Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Strukturen im Field Service

• Perspektivische Weiterentwicklung in die Rolle des elektrischen Betriebsleiters (Zeithorizont 1–3 Jahre)

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker, Elektromeister zwingend erforderlich

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Serviceumfeld; erste oder mehrjährige Führungserfahrung von Vorteil

• Erfahrung in industriellen Anwendungsbereichen, idealerweise in der Pumpen‑, Abwasser‑, Rechen‑, Filter‑ oder Gebläsetechnik

• Sehr gutes Verständnis für Arbeitssicherheit, Qualitätsanforderungen und technische Regelwerke

• Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägter Kommunikations‑ und Teamfähigkeit

• Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands (bis ca. 30 %)

• Wohnort im Raum Bonn oder angrenzend

What we offer you

• Abwechslungsreiche und verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben in einem professionellen Arbeitsumfeld

• Eigenständiges Arbeiten mit klaren Zuständigkeiten

• Zusammenarbeit in einem kollegialen Team

• Marktgerechte Vergütung

• Zugang zu einem Firmenwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung

• Sichere Perspektiven in einem langfristig ausgerichteten Unternehmen

• JobRad‑Leasing

• Kostenfreie Getränke (Kaffee & Wasser), Obstkorb und vergünstigtes Mittagsmenü

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die die kaufmännische und organisatorische Abwicklung von Standard‑ und Projektaufträgen übernimmt. • Ganzheitliche Abwicklung technisch und kaufmännisch vorbereiteter Standard‑ und Projektaufträge

• Terminplanung, ‑koordination und ‑überwachung im Projektverlauf

• Umsetzung und Nachverfolgung von Vertragsprotokollen

• Laufende Abstimmung und Korrespondenz mit internen Fachbereichen, Außendienst, Kunden, Lieferanten, Speditionen und Bauleitern (Deutsch & Englisch)

• Lieferantenkommunikation und ‑verhandlungen

jobs.title: Estagiário(a) Entrada de Pedidos
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Is responsible for supporting administrative or operational tasks while gaining practical experience. This role follows specific instructions and procedures and is designed to provide learning opportunities in a structured environment.
Principais Atividades

• Realizar a entrada de pedidos no sistema conforme informações recebidas da equipe comercial ou clientes

• Conferir dados de pedidos, como preços, prazos, condições comerciais e cadastros

• Apoiar na correção de inconsistências e acompanhamento de pendências

• Auxiliar na comunicação com áreas internas (Vendas, Logística, Financeiro)

• Manter registros e controles atualizados

• Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios simples e rotinas administrativas

Requisitos Básicos

• Cursando Administração, Gestão Comercial, Logística, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas afins

• Pacote Office básico

Convênio médico, odontológico e seguro de vida
Vale refeição e transporte público
Programa de bem-estar e Gympass
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR)
Ampla variedade de oportunidades de aprendizado

jobs.title: Technico-commercial sédentaire / Inside Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

About the role

Job Summary
The Sr. Tendering Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to sales teams and conducting technical analysis of product configurations to determine customer-specific pricing.
This job profile is intended for experienced professionals who apply practical knowledge of a job area and work independently with general supervision. Résumé du poste**

En tant que Technico-commercial sédentaire chez Sulzer Ensival Moret France SASU, vous serez un élément clé de notre équipe commerciale, chargé de développer et de maintenir d'excellentes relations avec nos clients, tout en assurant la promotion et la vente de nos solutions techniques.

Responsabilités**

* Gérer un portefeuille de clients existants et le cas échéant, prospecter de nouveaux clients par téléphone et par e-mail.
* Analyser les besoins techniques des clients et leur proposer des solutions adaptées parmi notre gamme de produits (pompes, agitateurs, etc.).
* Élaborer des offres commerciales détaillées et techniques, en collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de production.
* Négocier les conditions commerciales et conclure les ventes.
* Assurer le suivi des commandes, de la réception à la livraison, en coordination avec les services internes.
* Répondre aux demandes techniques des clients et les conseiller sur l'utilisation de nos produits.
* Participer à l'élaboration de la stratégie commerciale et au reporting des activités.
* Maintenir une veille technologique et concurrentielle sur le marché.

Qualifications**

* Diplôme technique (Bac+2 à Bac+5) en mécanique, électromécanique, génie des procédés ou équivalent.
* Expérience significative (minimum 3 ans) en vente de produits techniques industriels, idéalement dans le secteur des pompes ou équipements rotatifs.
* Excellentes compétences relationnelles et de communication, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
* Maîtrise des outils informatiques (CRM, Pack Office).
* Capacité à travailler en autonomie et en équipe.
* Sens de l'organisation, rigueur et proactivité.
* La maîtrise de l'anglais technique est un plus.

What we offer you

;

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
